llm_proposer.assessment: The most likely cause is a hard WSS input-port failure in the ROADM at S01. S01 is the sole element common to every affected working path, and blocking an arriving degree there explains the simultaneous loss of many channels and the downstream AMP_INPUT_LOS alarms on multiple S01 egress lines.

proposals.rationale: A failed WSS input port at the common S01 ROADM can block all channels arriving on that degree and propagate loss across several outgoing degrees, matching the widespread OCH/client failures and simultaneous O1/O2 amplifier input LOS. The main uncertainty is that the specific failed S01 degree is not identified in the brief.

A disconnected OMS input could directly cause AMP_INPUT_LOS and downstream channel loss. However, one connector at O1 would not naturally explain the simultaneous independent LOS on S01-S15 at O2 or the complete common-path pattern without an additional failure.

A switch-fabric failure at S01 could interrupt many ODUs at once. It is strongly disfavoured because it should produce ODU-layer failures without causing the observed optical-channel loss and amplifier input LOS.
